items.text: rustfmt had re-wrapped my test, so the text match missed. Reading the current form and editing that.

The inspector shows the raw enraged form, with lobes, lashing tentacles and pale dot-eyes, in both the orbit view and the game's top-down view. Every sphere in it is placed by the wasm.

Boss step 3 is done, which completes the characters roadmap. No character animation is left in JS.
- `make verify` passes with 417 tests.
- Playwright passes 20/20.
- All 6 render scripts pass.

## What changed

- **`src/render/shoggoth.rs`** now places every sphere and runs the wander behaviour.
  - Spheres placed: the mass, the tentacles, the dot eyes, and the mask and its break-up.
  - `boss_spheres(&BossPose)` is the entry point.
  - It answers "what does the boss look like at time t" as a list of 20-float spheres.
- **The port is bit-exact, proven with the same test-first process as the robots.**
  - I ran the real JS placement code under Bun with a mock GL and captured its sphere queue before touching it.
  - The first comparison matched on all 32,180 floats, with a maximum difference of 0. That includes the wander sim.
  - Two mutations, a tentacle constant and a wander constant, both fail the check.
  - `tests/fixtures/shoggoth_spheres.txt` (95 KB) is the frozen golden record.
- **Wire format.** A run of `SPHERE` ops (op 26, 20 floats each) is closed by `SHOGGOTH x y sizePx maskAt`.
  - Both ops are fixed-arity, so every stream walker keeps working unchanged.
  - The stream validator checks that the run is closed, that nothing interrupts it, and that the mask split falls inside it.
- **`web/shoggoth-core.js` went from 620 to 337 lines.**
  - It keeps the camera, the shading and the two draw paths.
  - Its instanced path uploads the engine's list directly as the instance buffer.
- **Tools.** `bossSpheres()` and `MASK_OFF_SECS` in `tools/engine-pose.js` read from `src/wasm_api.rs`.
  - `BOSS_MASK_OFF_SECS` is now the single definition.
  - The JS constant and its pin test are gone.

## Things to keep, and a correction

- **Correction: the wander state machine was not an inspector toy, as I told you earlier.**
  - The game never passes `lookUp`, so the mask's "stop and look up" beats in-game come from that state machine.
  - I ported it faithfully and made it a pure function of time.
  - The JS version depended on the order it was queried in.
- **Why bit-exactness was possible:**
  - The JS matrices lived in `Float32Array`s, so every product was rounded to f32 at each step.
  - The original used truncated literals: `6.283`, not τ.
  - Clippy wanted `TAU` there. I refused and documented why, because it would silently change the boss's motion.

## Checks beyond the suites

- **`shoggoth-parity`** now draws engine-placed spheres through both paths.
  - 45 frames show 0 differing pixels.
  - The reference path still counts up to 227 draws, so the engine emits exactly as many spheres as the JS did.
- **In-game,** 6,946 `SPHERE` ops were drawn across 114 boss frames with no errors. The boss looks right mid mask-off.
- **The inspector's boss views** load with no errors, both masked and enraged.

## Two things worth your attention

- **`shoggoth.rs` changed under me while I worked.**
  - **What changed:** the header was reworded, and a `Mat` type, an `Out` builder, a `WanderCache` and a public `wander()` appeared. It is 742 lines where mine was about 560. My guess is the parallel session did this.
  - **What I did:** I built on the on-disk version and did not fight it. It passes the golden record and keeps the API I use.
    - I added the missing `MASK_OFF_SECS`.
    - I fixed two clippy lints.
    - I added two pin tests.
  - **The risk:** two writers in one working tree are fragile. If that was unintended, it is worth a look.
- **Playwright also reported it was "just installed or updated" partway through.** I re-prepared the toolchain through `make check-render`, as CLAUDE.md prescribes.

## For your commit

You had already committed R3 and boss step 2 (`10bccd9`), so this diff is step 3 only.
- **New files:** `src/render/shoggoth.rs` and `tests/fixtures/shoggoth_spheres.txt`.
- **Staging:** nothing is staged.
- **The wasm on `:8080`** is rebuilt.
- **Suggested commit message:** `boss placed by the engine: render/shoggoth.rs (bit-exact port, golden record), SPHERE op run closed by SHOGGOTH, shoggoth-core.js draws the list only (620→337 lines) — characters roadmap complete, no animation left in JS`

## What's left in the known-debt list

- The WebAudio engine has no host tests. It would need a recording seam, as `Graphics` did.
- If you ever want them, the renderer's self-contained subsystems could become factories, each behind a pixel test first.
- Both are optional. Every refactor we set out to do is done.
